processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: 100 kW vacuum induction furnace, 0.5 kg ingots (Table 1 composition ranges)
Hot-rolled at 1150 °C obtaining 5 mm flat-products, followed by water quenching (this is the parent process proc_hot-rolled-1150c)
Heat treated at 600 °C for 30 min, followed by water quenching; tempering at 600 °C triggers slight/incipient transformations (discontinuous precipitation and precipitation transformation) in general

structures.overall_structure: Equiaxed austenite grains in which each grain contains fine parallel striations of a single orientation (direction changing grain to grain); no austenite transformation was detected at 600 °C, and secondary phases were detected only along grain boundaries (probably κ + α, with κ and/or M3C carbides along γ boundaries).

phases_present.morphology: equiaxed polygonal grains containing fine, closely spaced parallel striations (one striation orientation per grain)
continuous grain-boundary film / rib-like band along γ boundaries
along grain boundaries, appearing continuous with the adjacent grains

grain_structure.texture: Fine, closely spaced parallel striations inside every grain; each grain hosts striations of a single orientation and the striation direction changes from grain to grain

precipitates.type: κ + α (probably), with κ and/or M3C carbides along γ grain boundaries
precipitates.distribution: along γ grain boundaries (continuous grain-boundary film)
precipitates.coherency: continuous with the adjacent grain (evidence of continuity)
